launcher.notes: The self-updater really works: failed downloads no longer block retries (latch released in finally), downloads RESUME via HTTP Range with 5 attempts + MB progress + sha256, failed updates show the real error in the dialog, and the update check re-runs every 30 minutes while open. Bundles Client v2.9.19: the mod-menu gson StackOverflowError is fixed for good (reflection-free config io + Throwable-safe JSON paths + GuiGuard on menu click/close).

notes: Client v2.9.20: AutoGG detection rewritten - universal end-of-game phrase library (match over, has won, thanks for playing, victory/defeat, placement...) fires on every server and game mode, channel/player chat never triggers it, Hypixel mid-game eliminations no longer cause premature gg's.
